muteTest.reason: Every opening angle shows work, dependency, task focus, or an attention change; no reciprocal dialogue exchange is staged.

shots.job: Establish the owner as competent by observing a calibrated part operation.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: The owner measures and resets one metal component with both hands.
shots.whatStaysStill: The buyer, his closed notebook, the bench geography, wardrobe, and workshop lighting remain stable.
shots.screenDirection: Owner remains frame-left and buyer frame-right across the established action line.
shots.initialImage: Owner already has both hands on the part while the buyer observes.
shots.finalImage: The part remains on the bench and the owner finishes the demonstrated adjustment.

shots.job: Reveal the ordinary staff exception that makes the owner's absence consequential.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: A staff member holds the part while the owner gives one low directional cue.
shots.whatStaysStill: The buyer stays a foreground observer and the workshop, wardrobe, bench, and part remain continuous.
shots.screenDirection: The camera remains on the established side; owner-to-staff action stays leftward behind the buyer.
shots.initialImage: The staff member holds the recurring part within the established workshop.
shots.finalImage: The owner's small cue leaves the staff member carrying the immediate task.

shots.job: Keep both people occupied by the work as the narrator says she starts to answer.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: Owner and buyer lower their attention to the part and notebook without speaking.
shots.whatStaysStill: Camera, actor positions, bench, notebook, part, wardrobe, and lighting do not move or redesign.
shots.screenDirection: Owner remains left and buyer right on the original side of the action line.
shots.initialImage: Both participants look down toward the same work surface.
shots.finalImage: Their attention remains on the work rather than forming a question-and-answer eyeline.

sourceDerivation.transform: Static 512x288 crop at x=0,y=288; scaled to 1280x720. No temporal retiming or camera animation.

shots.job: Put the operating dependency on screen instead of constructing an unheard reply.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: The owner's hands remain with the same recurring metal part on the work surface.
shots.whatStaysStill: The crop, bench, part, owner position, workshop geography, wardrobe, and lighting remain fixed.
shots.screenDirection: The detail stays on the established camera side; the part remains frame-left and the owner's working hand frame-right.
shots.initialImage: The metal part and the owner's hands already occupy the work surface.
shots.finalImage: The same part remains visibly dependent on the owner's physical presence.

shots.job: Land the narrated stop on one irreversible attention shift, not visible speech.
shots.primaryPhysicalAction: The owner turns her attention once from the buyer toward the operation.
shots.whatStaysStill: Her mouth remains closed while the buyer, workshop, wardrobe, lighting, and camera remain stable.
shots.screenDirection: The close stays on the established side and her gaze moves toward the workshop, not across camera.
shots.initialImage: The owner faces the buyer with a closed mouth and settled posture.
shots.finalImage: Her eyes and head have shifted once toward the operation as the narration says she stops.
